relationship_summary.description: Narrative description of the relationship found. Present tense. Theoretical level.

converging_evidence.description: Incidents that SUPPORT the relationship (converge). Empty array if none.

diverging_evidence.description: Incidents that STRAIN the relationship. They are NOT refutations — they are expansion opportunities.

expansion_suggestion.description: How to expand the relationship to accommodate this diverging data (condition, subtype, context, alternative path).

shared_documents_without_clear_evidence.description: Documents with both categories but without clear evidence.

conceptual_fit.description: How well this relationship explains the participants' behavior.

elaboration_note.description: Free note: what insight emerged? What remains to be explored?

suggested_next_elaborations.description: Suggestions for next relationships to elaborate.
